title: Legacy Bed Recipe
description: A datapack which allows you to craft beds with any wool combination
body:
This datapack allows the user to craft a bed without needing the wool to be the same color.

The [Polymorph](https://modrinth.com/project/tagwiZkJ) mod is recommended to be installed as well so the user can choose the bed he wants to craft.
